title: RNA-seq 24 h p53 target vs proliferation fold change
what: CDKN1A fold change, or the p53-target / proliferation group medians (×)

reader_questions.question: What is the fold change of CDKN1A, or the typical fold change of the p53 target genes?
reader_questions.expected: CDKN1A rises ~7.0×; p53 targets rise ~2.5× median while proliferation genes fall to ~0.55×.

reader_questions.question: How many biological replicates back each gene?
How did housekeeping genes behave?
